item.text: {"decisions":[{"id":"duplicate-loader-attribution","verdict":"pass","reason":"Correctly identifies the two workspace-files inserts and locates the fatal duplicate at EntryGroup.update during Cordis include composition."},{"id":"three-layering-cases","verdict":"pass","reason":"Correctly distinguishes safe config override, safe new insertion, and fatal insertion of an already bundle-provided ID, with evidence-based classification."},{"id":"minimal-profile-fix","verdict":"pass","reason":"Prescribes removing only the profile’s redundant workspace-files insert, retaining the bundle declaration and using configuration override if needed."},{"id":"plugin-and-failure-boundary","verdict":"partial","reason":"Correctly states the failure occurs before plugin execution and cannot be fixed in plugin code, but does not explicitly separate the earlier resource-read failure as still requiring verification."},{"id":"author-and-host-prevention","verdict":"pass","reason":"Recommends inspecting the installed bundle patch and proposes an actionable diagnostic naming both sources and directing removal of the profile block."}],"caps":[{"id":"retain-or-add-duplicate","triggered":false,"reason":"The report explicitly rejects retaining the duplicate and does not recommend plugin edits as the remedy."}]}
